resumeText:
Dr. Ayesha Fernandes, BHMS | Bengaluru | ayesha.fernandes@example.com

EXPERIENCE
Medical Officer - Claims, Tungabhadra Health TPA Services (fictional), Bengaluru (2022 - present)
- Process cashless pre-authorisation requests from network hospitals for retail and group health policies.
- Adjudicated reimbursement claims against policy terms, exclusions, waiting periods and sub-limits.
- Scrutinise discharge summaries, investigation reports and hospital bills for medical necessity.
- Read diagnoses, procedures and treatment notes in case papers to check the line of treatment.
- Met turnaround time targets for cashless approvals during peak hospital discharge hours.
- Write query letters and deduction notes to hospitals and policyholders in clear language.
- Flagged suspicious claims with mismatched dates to the investigation team.

Clinical Intern, Government Homoeopathic Medical College Hospital, Bengaluru (2021 - 2022)
- Assisted OPD consultants and maintained patient case records.

EDUCATION
BHMS, Rajiv Gandhi University of Health Sciences, 2021

SKILLS
IRDAI guidelines, MS Excel, claims software
